source.member: CreatureAttribute.GetCurrent / ModifierType, CreatureVital.GetMaxValue / ModifierType, CreatureSkill.Current with enchantments and vitae
source.notes: in as in creature_stats plus in.enchantments = [spellId, spellCategory, powerLevel, statModType, statModKey, statModValue] in registry order (layer 1, start time 0). out.attributes[i] (Strength..Self by id) = [Current, GetCurrent(false), ModifierType]; out.vitals[i] = [MaxValue, GetMaxValue(false), ModifierType]; out.skills maps each biota skill to [Base, Current]. These exercise EnchantmentManager (unit 5.4) as well as the stat classes.
